newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:
Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said there would be one or two news conferences on the results of the Commission's weekly meeting after Wednesday's Commission briefing.
He said spokesman Nicolaas Wegter would be available at 1700/1600 GMT for a debriefing on Commissioner Hans van den Broek's meeting with Yugoslav Foreign Minister Milan Milutinovic.
Spokesman Jochen Kubosch briefed on the Court of Justice. He said a judgment had been taken in the T. Port case mainly relating to a question of procedure and not the banana market as such.
Kubosch also said that a list of traditional products that could be protected by member states had been approved during the Internal Market Council as an 'A' point.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1076: Second conference on fish management in the Mediterranean: common preservation regulation for all member states.
- IP/96/1077: Europartenariat Italia 1996.
- IP/96/1078: The Commission refers proposed concentrations RWE/Thyssengas and Bayernwerk/Isarwerke to the German Bundeskartellamt.
- IP/96/1079: The Commission completes packaging directive with rules for marking and for the assessment of compliance with the directive.
- Speech/96/302: Speech by Commissioner Padraig Flynn on "Jobs-the third way".
- Speech/96/304: Speech by Commissioner Emma Bonino at EuroMediterranean conference on water management.
- Main points in the Commission weekly meeting's agenda for November 27, 1996.
- Eurostat news release No 77/96: EU12 exports to South America up 18.4% in 1995.
- Eurostat; statistics in focus; external trade No 1996-10: EU trade with South America.
- Eurostat; statistics in focus; energy and industry No 1996-33: Beginning of an upturn in the construction industry?
- Portfolio on launching of Citizens First programme including:
-- IP/96/1070: Citizens First - raising people's awareness about their rights.
-- Citizens First: background statistics.
-- Selected Citizens First events in member states.
-- Citizens First - studying, training and doing research in another country of the EU.
